questions.question: The marked price of an item is 50% more than its cost price. The shopkeeper offers two successive discounts of 10% and 15%. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = 50% more than Cost Price (CP).

Discounts offered = 10% and 15% successively.

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (1 + 50/100)

Final Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts = MP × (1 - Discount₁) × (1 - Discount₂)

Profit Percentage = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

MP = CP × (1 + 50/100)

⇒ MP = CP × 1.5

Final Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts

SP = MP × (1 - 10/100) × (1 - 15/100)

SP = CP × 1.5 × 0.9 × 0.85

SP = CP × 1.1475

Profit Percentage = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

Profit Percentage = [(CP × 1.1475 - CP) / CP] × 100

Profit Percentage = [(1.1475 - 1) × 100]

Profit Percentage = 14.75%

**The shopkeeper's profit percentage is 14.75%.**

questions.question: If the radius of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 40% and its height is increased by 75%, its volume will be decreased by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial radius of the cylinder = r

Initial height of the cylinder = h

Initial volume of the cylinder = V = πr²h

New radius = 60% of r = 0.6r

New height = 175% of h = 1.75h

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Percentage change in volume = [(Initial Volume - New Volume) / Initial Volume] × 100

**Calculation:**

New Volume (V') = π(New radius)²(New height)

⇒ V' = π(0.6r)²(1.75h)

⇒ V' = π(0.36r²)(1.75h)

⇒ V' = π(0.63r²h)

New Volume = 63% of the Initial Volume

Percentage decrease in volume = 100% - 63%

⇒ Percentage decrease = 37%

**The volume will be decreased by 37%.**

questions.question: The average of 11 consecutive numbers is 30. The smallest number among these is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 11 consecutive numbers = 30

Number of terms = 11

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all terms) / (Number of terms)

Smallest number = Average - (Number of terms - 1) / 2

**Calculation:**

Sum of all terms = Average × Number of terms

⇒ Sum = 30 × 11

⇒ Sum = 330

Smallest number = Average - (Number of terms - 1) / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - (11 - 1) / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - 10 / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - 5

⇒ Smallest number = 25

**The smallest number among these is 25.**

questions.question: In how many years will ₹4,000 invested at the rate of 18% per annum simple interest amounts to ₹5,800?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate of Interest (R) = 18% per annum

Amount (A) = ₹5800

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

Time (T) = SI / (P × R / 100)

**Calculation:**

SI = A - P

⇒ SI = 5800 - 4000

⇒ SI = ₹1800

T = SI / (P × R / 100)

⇒ T = (1800 × 100) / (4000 × 18 )

⇒ T = 1800 / (720)

⇒ T = 2.5 years

**The time required is 2.5 years.**

questions.question: Express 29.5% as a ratio in the simplest form.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage = 29.5%

**Formula Used:**

Percentage can be expressed as a ratio by dividing the percentage value by 100.

Ratio = Percentage / 100

**Calculation:**

29.5% = 29.5 / 100

⇒ Ratio = 29.5 : 100

To simplify the ratio, multiply both terms by 10 to remove the decimal:

⇒ Ratio = (29.5 × 10) : (100 × 10)

⇒ Ratio = 295 : 1000

Simplify by dividing both terms by their greatest common divisor (GCD):

GCD of 295 and 1000 is 5.

⇒ Ratio = (295 / 5) : (1000 / 5)

⇒ Ratio = 59 : 200

**The ratio in the simplest form is 59 : 200.**

questions.question: If 5 + x, 2x + 7, 6x + 9 and y are in proportion when x = 2, then find the value of y.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The terms are in proportion: 5 + x , 2x + 7 , 6x + 9 , and y .

Value of x = 2 .

**Formula Used:**

If four terms are in proportion, then:

(a / b) = (c / d)

Cross multiplication yields:

a × d = b × c

**Calculation:**

Substitute x = 2 into the terms:

5 + x = 5 + 2 = 7

2x + 7 = 2(2) + 7 = 4 + 7 = 11

6x + 9 = 6(2) + 9 = 12 + 9 = 21

The terms become: 7 , 11 , 21 , y .

Using proportion:

(7 / 11) = (21 / y)

Cross multiply:

7 × y = 11 × 21

⇒ y = (11 × 21) / 7

⇒ y = 231 / 7

⇒ y = 33

**The value of y is 33.**

questions.question: An item was sold for ₹40 with a profit of 15%. If it were sold for ₹36, then what would have been the percentage of profit or loss? (rounded off to 1 decimal places).
questions.solution:

Selling price when profit is 15% = ₹40

Selling price if sold = ₹36

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 + Profit%)

Profit or Loss% = ((Selling Price - Cost Price) / Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost Price when SP = ₹40 and Profit = 15%

CP = 40 / (1 + 15/100)

⇒ CP = 40 / (1.15)

⇒ CP = ₹34.78

Now, when SP = ₹36

Profit or Loss = SP - CP

⇒ Profit or Loss = 36 - 34.78

⇒ Profit = ₹1.22

Profit% = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ Profit% = (1.22 / 34.78) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 3.5%

**The percentage of profit is 3.5%.**

questions.question: The average of 7 numbers is 10.8. If the average of the first three be 10.5 and that of the last three is 11.4, find the value of the middle number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 7 numbers = 10.8

Average of the first 3 numbers = 10.5

Average of the last 3 numbers = 11.4

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Sum of 7 numbers = 10.8 × 7

⇒ Sum of 7 numbers = 75.6

Sum of the first 3 numbers = 10.5 × 3

⇒ Sum of the first 3 numbers = 31.5

Sum of the last 3 numbers = 11.4 × 3

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = 34.2

Sum of the first 3 numbers + Last 3 numbers + Middle number = Sum of 7 numbers

⇒ 31.5 + 34.2 + Middle number = 75.6

⇒ Middle number = 75.6 - (31.5 + 34.2)

⇒ Middle number = 75.6 - 65.7

⇒ Middle number = 9.9

**The value of the middle number is 9.9.**

questions.question:
The following bar graph shows the export and import of goods (in lakh numbers) of a company in consecutive years 2018 to 2022. What will be the growth percentage for imports from 2018 to 2021? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Imports in 2018 = 60 lakh

Imports in 2021 = 110 lakh

Growth Percentage = ((Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

questions.question: If P is a prime number, then the LCM of P and its successive number would be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P is a prime number.

We need to find the LCM of P and its successive number (P + 1).

**Formula Used:**

LCM of two numbers = Product of the numbers / GCD of the numbers

**Calculation:**

Since P is a prime number, its GCD with its successive number (P + 1) is 1 (because consecutive numbers are always coprime).

LCM(P, P + 1) = (P × (P + 1)) / GCD(P, P + 1)

⇒ LCM(P, P + 1) = (P × (P + 1)) / 1

⇒ LCM(P, P + 1) = P × (P + 1)

**The LCM of P and its successive number (P + 1) is P(P + 1).**

questions.question: The lengths of two sides of a parallelogram are 6 cm and 20 cm. What is the sum of the squares of the diagonals of the parallelogram (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of two sides of the parallelogram = 6 cm and 20 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of the squares of the diagonals of a parallelogram = 2 × (a² + b²), where a and b are the lengths of the adjacent sides.

**Calculation:**

Lengths of adjacent sides, a = 6 cm, b = 20 cm.

Sum of squares of the diagonals = 2 × (a² + b²).

⇒ Sum of squares of the diagonals = 2 × (6² + 20²).

⇒ Sum of squares of the diagonals = 2 × (36 + 400).

⇒ Sum of squares of the diagonals = 2 × 436.

⇒ Sum of squares of the diagonals = 872 cm².

**The sum of the squares of the diagonals of the parallelogram is 872 cm².**

questions.question: Two trains of lengths 108 metre and 112 metre are running at speeds of 45 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how many seconds will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 108 m

Length of Train 2 = 112 m

Speed of Train 1 = 45 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 54 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

Relative Speed = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2 (for opposite directions)

Convert km/h to m/s using 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed in km/h = 45 + 54

Relative Speed in km/h = 99 km/h

Convert Relative Speed to m/s: Relative Speed = 99 × (5 / 18)

Relative Speed = 27.5 m/s

Total Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2

Total Distance = 108 + 112

Total Distance = 220 m

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

⇒
 Time = 220 / 27.5

⇒ Time = 8 seconds

**The trains will cross each other in 8 seconds.**
